content: Complete JWT utils implementation and testing

testCases.description: Unit tests for all JWT utility functions with positive, negative, and edge cases

subagent.description: Analyze JWT TypeScript compilation error, understand jsonwebtoken v9 type system, and design correct type-safe solution

phase1_gather.description: Gather type definitions, package versions, and existing patterns

Understand what StringValue type represents in jsonwebtoken v9

Review jsonwebtoken v8→v9 migration guide if available

phase2_analyze.description: Perform root cause analysis of TypeScript error
objectives: Explain WHY TypeScript rejects 'string' type for expiresIn parameter
Explain WHAT StringValue type is and how it differs from regular string
Identify WHY previous type assertions ('as string | number') failed
Determine if there are breaking changes in jsonwebtoken v9 type definitions
Analyze type compatibility between string literals and StringValue
phase2_analyze.outputFormat: Root cause explanation with type theory details and TypeScript behavior analysis

phase3_design.description: Design type-safe solution that satisfies TypeScript compiler
objectives: Design correct type declaration for JWT_EXPIRES_IN constant
Design correct way to pass expiresIn to jwt.sign() options
Ensure solution supports environment variable overrides
Plan verification steps to confirm fix works
phase3_design.outputFormat: Code solution with inline comments explaining type decisions + verification plan

phase4_approve.description: Present complete analysis and solution for user approval before implementation
phase4_approve.presentationFormat: ROOT CAUSE → SOLUTION CODE → TYPE EXPLANATION → VERIFICATION PLAN
